_comment: The pack table. One row per piece-version; one row = one /Game/DCContent/<id>_<v>/ folder,
one PrimaryAssetLabel, one cook chunk, one pack in unreal\_packs\.
chunk_id is FROZEN. A chunk id is baked into the file name the cook writes
(pakchunk<id>-Windows.pak), so changing one silently re-points every pack staged, signed or
referenced before the change. Add new pieces at the end; never renumber an existing row.
(The one renumber this table will ever have had is its own creation in brief 006, which
replaced the two ad-hoc ids brief 004 used for its two-piece spike.)
brand_hex / emblem are the identity the spike run happens to dress each piece in. They are
runtime inputs - nothing brand-specific is baked into a pack - so the server will override
them per region. They live here only so one run produces a contact sheet on which every
piece wears a different brand, which is what makes the sign fix visible.
Everything else about a piece (size class, bounds, sockets, door) comes from the art's own
manifest at art/export/<id>_<v>/manifest.json; it is deliberately not duplicated here.
